note: Neutral wording. E2.2 swaps this file for variants and measures the shift in the confusion matrix.

descriptions.browse_file: Walk through one source file and report what it declares, in the order the declarations appear.
descriptions.code_insight: Characterize a whole repository: size, languages, entry points, and overall shape.
descriptions.context: Assemble the source lines surrounding a given file location into one payload.
descriptions.debug_info: Report the indexer's internal diagnostic record for one path, including how it was parsed.
descriptions.find_files: List files whose path matches a name fragment or glob.
descriptions.get_context: Gather everything known about one named symbol: definition, documentation, and related symbols.
descriptions.git_analysis: Report version-control facts for the checkout: current commit, authors, and change history.
descriptions.index_stats: Report whether the corpus is ingested and how many entries the index holds.
descriptions.info: Describe the operations this server offers and what each one does.
descriptions.inspect_symbol: Given one exact symbol name, report its declaration site, signature, and kind.
descriptions.list_symbols: Return a flat machine-readable list of the declarations in one file.
descriptions.search: Find occurrences of a text pattern anywhere in the indexed corpus.
descriptions.semantic_annotations: Collect the @lci markers authors left in the source.
descriptions.side_effects: For one function, report the external state it mutates and the routines it invokes.
